title: 🚩 Evidence Flags: More trust signal, fewer words
summary: Evidence Flags is a Copilot skill that adds brief labels to claims to distinguish what is backed by evidence, reported by users, or inferred by the model. It helps when explicitly requested via /ef commands to clarify trust levels in responses without cluttering simple questions.
key_points: Uses seven labeled tags across two families: provenance (Supported, Reported, Unchecked) and AI analysis (Inferred, Hypothesis, Forecast, Judgment), plus optional warnings for contested or time-sensitive claims
Activated only when explicitly requested with /ef commands like /ef on, /ef check, /ef trail, keeping normal conversations unaffected
Helps distinguish between what Copilot verified in files, what users stated, and what the model deduced, without subjective qualifiers like maybe or seems
Does not verify truth, assign confidence scores, or replace technical review; Supported means claim is backed by evidence inspected in that conversation only

quotes.text: Instead of filling a response with qualifiers such as maybe, I think, or it seems, a brief label is added to relevant claims.
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains the core design principle: using structured labels instead of hedging language makes trust levels explicit and scannable.

quotes.text: Supported does not mean absolute truth: it means the claim is supported by evidence the model inspected during that conversation.
quotes.why_it_matters: Critical boundary on what the skill does: it clarifies context-specific verification, not universal truth.
